description:
Entities near a location (the primitive `look_from` builds on). Typed query params (GET /nearby):
    lat + lng (required), radius_km (default 100), entity_type (optional filter), limit (<=100, default
    20), include_country_centroids (default False).  Carries `source_tier`/`tier_label`.Metered: charged to your own wallet — see the server instructions (CHARGING); quote first with `billing_quote`.

entity_type.description: Entity kind: deposit | infrastructure | company | project. Optional filter; default all four.
entity_type.title: Entity Type

include_country_centroids.description: Also return country-centre placeholder pins (entities known only by country). Default false.
include_country_centroids.title: Include Country Centroids

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, -90 to 90 (WGS84). Required.
lat.title: Lat

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Up to 100. Default 20.
limit.title: Limit

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, -180 to 180 (WGS84). Required.
lng.title: Lng

name: nearby
